content: Obunnoged-iba-nasgu, itoged-iba-geb-naguded-oiboargu, María-Magdalena, degi, María-baid, neg-uan-dakega nonimalad.
Degi, negabandur-dummad nagunonikid, ar ade, Bab-Dummad-e-baliwitur-nibneggi-danikid, napnegse nonikid. A-baliwitur, akwa-dummad neg-uan-yawagak-idu-siid onirnonikid, geb a-akwa-birgi sigisad.
Baliwitur-e-dakleged mar-gaedyob dakleged, degine, e-mor ise-sibudik, dakuu daklebalid.
A-dobedbali, suar-ibmala wawanmakdemalad, burgwisayob nadmalad.
Ar baliwiturdi omeganga sogded: —Mer be dobgumar. Ar bemar Jesús-nakrusgi-bioklesgusad-amidanimalad an wisid.
Jesús wegi bar maisulid. Ar igi bemarga sogsagusa, deyob gusad. Jesús gannar durgusad. Be dakdamar, Dummad-Jesús-mai-gusad-e-gannar be dakmar.
Be gwae namar, e-sapinganga be sognamar: ‘Emi, Jesús burgwar-mamaid-abargi gannar durgusye. Bemar-idu Galilea-yarse nadmarye, agi be dakmaloye.’ Bato be wismarsoggu, be sognamarsun.
Degi, omegan neg-uangi-nodgu, Jesús-sapinganga Jesús-durgusye-sognamalaga, dobed-abargi, degi, nue-weligwar-itogedgi, abarmakdemalad.
Degine, omegan gayaburba-nued sognadmargu, egi Jesús noalid, ega sogded: “¡Na, degite!” Degi, omegan ese walikgunonimargu, e-mali angaagwar gasmalad, degi, Jesús-nug odummodmarsunnad.
Geb degi, Jesús amarga sogded: —Mer be dobgumar, be namar. An-gwenadmarga gayaburba-nued be sognamar, adi, Galilea-yarse namalagar, agi an-dakmalagar.
Suar-ibmala, ibmar-daksad-sogsamalad
Ar omegan nadapmargu, suar-ibmala-abar, bela neg-uangi-ibmar-gusad dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummaganga-sogega neggweburse nadmarmogad.
Dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummagan, Judío-girmar-dummaganse gochamargu, igar itosmalad. Degi, Judío-dummagan, suar-ibmalaga mani-ichesur uksamalad.
Amarga sogsamalad: —Bemar sogo: ‘Anmar gabmamaigu, Jesús-sapingan mutikidba nonimarye, Jesús-mui atursasmarye.’
Ar Roma-dummad-negdakmaid degi-itoalile, anmar-ebo sunmakoed, mer be-oakalomalagar.

Suar-ibmala mani-susmargu, ar igi Judío-dummagan ega sogsamala, deyob imaksamalad. Ar deyob, Judíoʼmar-abargi we-gaya amba emi-ibase soglediid: “Suar-ibmala-gabmamaigu, Jesús-e-sapingan Jesús-mui atursasmarye.”
Jesús e-igargi-sunmakega igar-uksad
Jesús-e-sapingan-ambe-gakagwensak-guedi (11), Galileaʼse nadmalad. Bia Jesús ega sogsagusa, a-yar-mulluse be naoye, ase nadmarsunnad.
E-sapingan Jesús-dakarmargu, e-abin sindigar sigidmalad, e-nug odummodmalad. Amba gwenna-gwenna e-sapingan egi bengusmalad.
Jesús e-sapingan-walikgunonigu, amarga sogded: —We-napneggi-negdakega, degine, nibneggi-negdakega, Bab-Dummad bela gangued anga uksad.

Degisoggu, be namar, bela-dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad an-sapinganga gued be imaknamar. Amar Bab-Dummad-nuggi, Bab-Dummad-Machi-nuggi, degi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-nuggi, Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi-oglegega, be imaknamar.
An bemar-odurdaksadba bela eba nue-nanamaloye be amar-odurdako. Napira an bemarga soged, an emi bemarba we-napneg-berguedse, bane-bane an gudiguoed. Be itogua.
